title: Windows Hyperlink Path Performance Optimization
mini_srs: This sub-milestone optimizes hyperlink path handling on Windows by replacing Path::canonicalize with std::path::absolute to avoid filesystem access. This dramatically improves performance in large repositories with lots of matches by eliminating costly filesystem operations during path resolution.

title: Hyperlink Alias Modular Architecture Restructuring
mini_srs: This sub-milestone restructures the hyperlink alias system in grep-printer. Commit 66aa4a6 creates a modular hyperlink architecture by splitting hyperlink.rs into hyperlink/mod.rs and hyperlink/aliases.rs exporting a public HyperlinkAlias type with display priority support. Commit 78383de extends this by adding description fields to aliases and improving zsh --hyperlink-format completions.

title: Replacement Text Support in JSON Output Mode
mini_srs: This milestone adds -r/--replace flag support to JSON output mode. Commit 292bc54 introduces a replacement field to each submatch object in JSON output allowing consumers to access both original match text and replacement text without performing substitution themselves. This closes issue #1872 and #2883.

title: Nested Alternation Groups Support in Glob Patterns
mini_srs: This sub-milestone adds support for nested alternations in glob patterns. For example patterns like **/{node_modules/**/*/{ts js} crates/**/*.{rs toml}} are now correctly parsed. This enhancement restructures the Parser with separate alternates_stack and branches tracking.

title: Unclosed Character Class Toggle for Glob Parsing
mini_srs: This sub-milestone adds an allow_unclosed_class toggle for gitignore-compatible glob parsing. When enabled patterns like [abc or [] are treated as if the opening bracket is a literal character instead of returning a parse error. This enables compatibility with gitignore behavior.

title: GlobSet API Enhancements with matches_all and Constructor
mini_srs: This milestone extends the GlobSet public API with two complementary enhancements. The matches_all method enables checking if ALL globs in a set match a given path returning true only when every glob matches. Additionally GlobSet::new is made public and generalized to accept any iterator of Glob references improving ergonomics for users who already have a Vec of Glob.

title: Fix gitignore path filtering in subdirectories and parent ignore files
mini_srs: This milestone fixes critical bugs in gitignore path stripping when searching subdirectories or when .ignore files exist in parent directories. The previous code deleted too many path components when constructing absolute paths for pattern matching causing incorrect gitignore filtering. Commit 14f4957 fixes the core path construction issue and 0407e10 handles an edge case when searching with just a dot path.

title: Fix Global Gitignore Matching with Absolute Paths
mini_srs: This milestone fixes how global gitignore files from ~/.gitconfig core.excludesFile or --ignore-file flag are interpreted when ripgrep is given absolute paths to search. Previously anchored patterns like /foo would not match correctly because global gitignores were not properly associated with the current working directory. The fix adds CWD tracking to WalkBuilder and IgnoreBuilder.

title: Add Jujutsu VCS (.jj) directory support
mini_srs: This milestone adds support for Jujutsu (jj) version control system by recognizing .jj directories alongside .git directories. When a .jj directory is present ripgrep will treat the directory as a VCS repository and respect .gitignore files enabling ripgrep default gitignore-aware behavior for jj repositories.

title: Add Minimum Depth Option for Directory Traversal
mini_srs: This milestone adds a min_depth option to WalkBuilder that mimics the eponymous option in walkdir. It allows filtering out directory entries below a minimum depth threshold during traversal. The implementation adds min_depth field to WalkBuilder and WalkParallel propagates it to Worker struct and filters entries in run_one method based on depth comparison.

title: Fix parallel argument processing order
mini_srs: This milestone fixes the order in which command line arguments are processed during parallel searches. Previously when searching in parallel with many more arguments than threads the first arguments were searched last due to LIFO stack processing combined with round-robin distribution. The fix reverses the input order before distribution so the two reversals cancel out.

title: Fix Performance with Large After-Context Flag Values
mini_srs: This milestone fixes two related performance bugs with the -A/--after-context flag in the grep-searcher crate. Commit 8c6595c addresses an exponential slowdown when searching stdin with large after-context values. Commit d4b77a8 is a follow-up optimization that changes context_start calculation to use before_context instead of max_context() skipping the costly line-preceding step when before_context==0.

title: Migrate Max Matches Limit from Printer to Searcher
mini_srs: This sub-milestone performs the core architectural migration of max_matches limit handling from grep-printer to grep-searcher crate. Commit a6e0be3 adds max_matches to SearcherBuilder and removes the related logic from Standard printer. Commit fdea972 adds documentation clarifying edge cases where max-count may print more matches than specified. This is a breaking change for grep-printer.

title: Simplify Printer max_matches After Searcher Migration
mini_srs: This sub-milestone completes the removal of max_matches from the grep-printer crate by removing the max_matches configuration from JSON and Summary printers. This cleanup is the final step in the architectural migration to grep-searcher and fixes issue #3076.

title: Rust 2024 Edition Migration
mini_srs: This milestone migrates all ripgrep crates from Rust edition 2021 to 2024 to enable newer Rust features such as let chains. The migration involves updating the edition field in all crate Cargo.toml files and adapting code patterns to comply with Rust 2024 style changes such as removing redundant ref keywords in match patterns.

title: Switch to tikv-jemallocator Dependency
mini_srs: This milestone replaces the deprecated jemallocator crate with tikv-jemallocator for the jemalloc allocator used on 64-bit musl targets. The change addresses compilation issues on riscv64gc-unknown-linux-musl platforms and aligns with the current recommended jemalloc crate.

title: Add Highlight Color Type for Matching Lines
mini_srs: This milestone adds a new highlight color type to the --colors flag that enables users to apply distinct styling to non-matching text within matching lines. The feature is implemented across three files: crates/core/flags/defs.rs crates/printer/src/color.rs and crates/printer/src/standard.rs.

title: Add as_match Method to Captures Trait
mini_srs: This milestone adds a convenience method as_match() to the Captures trait in the grep-matcher crate. The method returns the overall match for a capture equivalent to self.get(0).unwrap() providing a cleaner API for accessing the full match without explicit indexing.

title: Crate Version Releases
mini_srs: This milestone consolidates all crate version release commits. Includes globset-0.4.16 and 0.4.17 - grep-searcher-0.1.15 - grep-cli-0.1.12 - ignore-0.4.24 - grep-pcre2-0.1.9 - grep-printer-0.3.0 - grep-matcher-0.1.8 - grep-0.4.0 - grep-regex-0.1.14. These are version bumps for semver-compatible and semver-incompatible releases.

title: Dependency Updates
mini_srs: This milestone consolidates dependency update commits. Includes bumping internal crate dependencies (globset - grep-matcher - grep-pcre2 - grep-cli - grep-searcher - grep-regex) and external dependencies (crossbeam-channel 0.5.13 to 0.5.15).

title: File Type Definition Additions
mini_srs: This milestone consolidates file type definition additions to the ignore crate. Adds support for Seed7 - .env/sh - Makefile.* - Qt resources - GDScript - Terraform - msbuild - Kconfig - ColdFusion/BoxLang - typst - devicetree dtso - bazel WORKSPACE.bzlmod - LLVM - lowercase R extensions - Svelte TypeScript - scdoc - Gleam - Ruby rake files.

title: Documentation Updates
mini_srs: This milestone consolidates documentation improvements. Clarifies -c/--count inconsistency - resolve_binary docs - man page hyphen escaping - require_git(false) behavior - .git hidden flag coverage - multiline count behavior - WalkBuilder::filter_entry - --ignore-file precedence.

title: Code Style Refactoring to Modern Rust Idioms
mini_srs: This milestone consolidates code style and refactoring commits. Includes rustfmt 2024 formatting - simplified string formatting - Clippy lint fixes - atomic ordering simplification - removal of __Nonexhaustive work-around - minor code simplifications in printer.

title: Exit Code and Search Worker Initialization Bug Fixes
mini_srs: This sub-milestone contains higher-impact bug fixes and enhancements. Includes: summary printer has_match fix (126bbea) - replacement panic fix (9164158) - --stats for --json support (6f39f83) - GlobSet::empty const and Candidate::from_bytes additions.

Includes: decompression reader optimization (64174b8) - BOM handling fix - bytes searched stats fix - trailing dot in filenames fix - --crlf --replace line terminator fix - -l with --pcre2 --multi fix - encoding log message - fish completions config - compact Debug impl - italic color style - multithreading heuristic - rg -vf behavior.
